name: vox
note: Explainer motion-graphics look: everything sits on TEXTURED PAPER (never flat colour), type is an editorial serif for statements and a condensed caps face for labels, and the accent is a single red used for tags, ticks and caption pills. The cut changes layout every ~1.6-2.1s so it reads as an explainer rather than a talking head with captions. Fonts are free from Google Fonts; the pack IS the look, so a substitution is a different video.

font.install: Free from Google Fonts: fonts.google.com/specimen/Oswald - download and double-click to install.
